name: MDF MD One Rose Gold Stethoscope, Black Tube
seoTitle: Rose Gold Stethoscope with Black Tube for Nurses
metaDescription: An MDF MD One stainless steel stethoscope with rose gold accents and a black tube, a polished graduation or Nurses Week gift that still looks professional.
summary: Rose gold hardware on a black tube gives this stainless steel MDF stethoscope a refined look, a lovely upgrade for a new grad or seasoned nurse.
whyItWorks: Rose gold on a black tube is a quietly stylish combination. It catches the eye without being loud, so it suits nurses who want something a little special but still prefer a classic look on the unit. For someone who has used the same basic student stethoscope since their first semester, it feels like a genuine step up and a sign that they have arrived.

MDF lists the MD One as a stainless steel model, a move up from the entry level options many students start with. As a gift, it fits graduation, passing the NCLEX, starting a first nursing job, or a well earned Nurses Week treat from a partner or parent. Anyone hoping to personalize it can add an engraved ID tag, since this particular listing is not the engravable version. Either way, it is a present that gets carried on every single shift.
goodToKnow: This listing is the black tube version, and a white tube and an engravable option are listed separately.
Check the listing for what comes in the box, such as spare ear tips.
An ID tag with their name is an easy way to personalize it.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a new nurse?
faq.a: Yes. A stethoscope they will carry daily is a meaningful graduation or first job gift, and the black tube keeps it professional.
This listing is not the engravable version. MDF sells an engravable MD One separately, or you can add a personalized ID tag.
